title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Strawberry Watermelon Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Strawberry Watermelon by Doozy Infinity brings together two summer staples in a juicy, sweet-tasting blend. Ripe Strawberry leads the way with its bright, jammy flavour, while Watermelon adds a gentle sweetness and lush, refreshing lift. The combination delivers a fruit vape that’s clean, rounded and irresistibly smooth, making it a great choice for an easy, all-day vape. Blended at a 70VG/30PG ratio, this high-VG shortfill is best suited to Sub-Ohm vaping with powerful direct-to-lung (DTL) kits. Each 120ml bottle contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, leaving space to add two 10ml nic shots to customise your nicotine level. Doozy Infinity’s Shortfill range is crafted for thicker vapour production and bold fruit flavour, ideal for fans of flavour-packed Sub-Ohm blends.
